CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_reconcile_coachingos_subscription_status()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  changed_count integer := 0;
begin
  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.platform_admins p
    where p.user_id = (select auth.uid())
  ) then
    raise exception 'Platform Super Admin access required'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  update public.institute_subscriptions s
  set status = 'past_due',
      updated_at = now()
  where
    (s.status = 'trial'
      and coalesce(s.trial_ends_at, s.current_period_end) is not null
      and coalesce(s.trial_ends_at, s.current_period_end) <= now())
    or
    (s.status = 'active'
      and s.current_period_end is not null
      and s.current_period_end <= now());

  get diagnostics changed_count = row_count;
  return changed_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_revoke_coachingos_staff_invitation(_institute_id uuid, _invitation_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
                                                                                                                                                  declare
                                                                                                                                                    caller_role text;
                                                                                                                                                    begin
                                                                                                                                                      select m.role into caller_role
                                                                                                                                                        from public.institute_members m
                                                                                                                                                          where m.institute_id = _institute_id
                                                                                                                                                              and m.user_id = (select auth.uid());

                                                                                                                                                                if coalesce(caller_role,'') not in ('owner','admin') then
                                                                                                                                                                    raise exception 'Only institute owner or admin can revoke invitations'
                                                                                                                                                                          using errcode = '42501';
                                                                                                                                                                            end if;

                                                                                                                                                                              update public.institute_staff_invitations
                                                                                                                                                                                set status = 'revoked', revoked_at = now()
                                                                                                                                                                                  where id = _invitation_id
                                                                                                                                                                                      and institute_id = _institute_id
                                                                                                                                                                                          and status = 'pending';

                                                                                                                                                                                            return found;
                                                                                                                                                                                            end;
                                                                                                                                                                                            $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_upsert_coachingos_plan(_id text, _name text, _monthly_price numeric, _is_active boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
                                                                                                  begin
                                                                                                    if not exists (
                                                                                                        select 1 from public.platform_admins p
                                                                                                            where p.user_id = (select auth.uid())
                                                                                                              ) then
                                                                                                                  raise exception 'Platform Super Admin access required'
                                                                                                                        using errcode = '42501';
                                                                                                                          end if;

                                                                                                                            if coalesce(length(trim(_id)),0) < 2
                                                                                                                                 or coalesce(length(trim(_name)),0) < 2
                                                                                                                                      or _monthly_price is null
                                                                                                                                           or _monthly_price < 0 then
                                                                                                                                               raise exception 'Provide a valid plan ID, name and non-negative price';
                                                                                                                                                 end if;

                                                                                                                                                   insert into public.subscription_plans(id,name,monthly_price,is_active)
                                                                                                                                                     values (lower(trim(_id)),trim(_name),_monthly_price,coalesce(_is_active,true))
                                                                                                                                                       on conflict (id) do update
                                                                                                                                                           set name = excluded.name,
                                                                                                                                                                   monthly_price = excluded.monthly_price,
                                                                                                                                                                           is_active = excluded.is_active;

                                                                                                                                                                             return true;
                                                                                                                                                                             end;
                                                                                                                                                                             $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_manage_coachingos_records(_institute_id uuid, _record_type text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select public.coachingos_subscription_write_allowed(_institute_id)
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.institute_members m
      join public.institutes i on i.id = m.institute_id
      where m.institute_id = _institute_id
        and m.user_id = (select auth.uid())
        and i.status = 'active'
        and (
          m.role in ('owner','admin','manager')
          or (m.role = 'teacher' and _record_type in ('batches','routine','attendance','exams'))
          or (m.role = 'accountant' and _record_type in ('fees','expenses','payroll'))
          or (m.role = 'receptionist' and _record_type in ('students','attendance','fees'))
        )
    );

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_coachingos_guardian_deliveries(_institute_id uuid, _attendance_record_id uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF guardian_delivery_logs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  return query
  update public.guardian_delivery_logs l
  set status = 'processing',
      attempt_count = l.attempt_count + 1,
      processing_started_at = pg_catalog.now(),
      updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
  where l.institute_id = _institute_id
    and l.attendance_record_id = _attendance_record_id
    and l.channel = 'sms'
    and l.status = 'queued'
    and l.attempt_count < 3
    and (l.next_attempt_at is null or l.next_attempt_at <= pg_catalog.now())
  returning l.*;
end;
$function$

functions.name: claim_due_coachingos_guardian_sms
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_due_coachingos_guardian_sms(_batch_size integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS SETOF guardian_delivery_logs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if _batch_size < 1 or _batch_size > 200 then
    raise exception 'batch_size must be between 1 and 200';
  end if;

  -- Recover jobs abandoned in processing for over 10 minutes.
  update public.guardian_delivery_logs l
  set status = case when l.attempt_count >= 3 then 'failed' else 'queued' end,
      next_attempt_at = case when l.attempt_count >= 3 then null
        else pg_catalog.now() + interval '2 minutes' end,
      processing_started_at = null,
      error_message = 'processing_lease_expired',
      updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
  where l.channel = 'sms'
    and l.status = 'processing'
    and l.processing_started_at < pg_catalog.now() - interval '10 minutes';

  return query
  with due as (
    select l.id
    from public.guardian_delivery_logs l
    where l.channel = 'sms'
      and l.status = 'queued'
      and l.attempt_count < 3
      and (l.next_attempt_at is null or l.next_attempt_at <= pg_catalog.now())
    order by coalesce(l.next_attempt_at,l.created_at), l.created_at
    for update skip locked
    limit _batch_size
  )
  update public.guardian_delivery_logs l
  set status = 'processing',
      attempt_count = l.attempt_count + 1,
      processing_started_at = pg_catalog.now(),
      updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
  from due
  where l.id = due.id
  returning l.*;
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.coachingos_subscription_write_allowed(_institute_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    public.is_coachingos_super_admin()
    or not exists (
      select 1
      from public.institute_subscriptions s
      where s.institute_id = _institute_id
    )
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.institute_subscriptions s
      where s.institute_id = _institute_id
        and (
          (s.status = 'active' and
            (s.current_period_end is null or s.current_period_end > now()))
          or
          (s.status = 'trial' and
            coalesce(s.trial_ends_at, s.current_period_end) > now())
        )
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_coachingos_institute_members(_institute_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, email text, phone text, role text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.has_coachingos_institute_role(_institute_id, array['owner','admin','manager']::text[]) then
      raise exception 'Institute roster access required' using errcode = '42501';
        end if;
          return query
              select m.user_id, u.email::text, nullif(u.phone, '')::text, m.role, m.created_at
                  from public.institute_members m join auth.users u on u.id = m.user_id
                      where m.institute_id = _institute_id
                          order by case m.role when 'owner' then 0 when 'admin' then 1 when 'manager' then 2 else 3 end, m.created_at;
                          end;
                          $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_coachingos_notifications(_institute_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, category text, title text, message text, actor_user_id uuid, entity_id uuid, read_at timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.institute_members m
    join public.institutes i on i.id = m.institute_id
    where m.institute_id = _institute_id
      and m.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and i.status = 'active'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Active institute membership required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  return query
  select n.id, n.category, n.title, n.message, n.actor_user_id,
         n.entity_id, n.read_at, n.created_at
  from public.institute_notifications n
  where n.institute_id = _institute_id
    and n.recipient_user_id = (select auth.uid())
  order by n.created_at desc
  limit 100;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_coachingos_platform_overview()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
                                                                                                                                                                             declare
                                                                                                                                                                               result jsonb;
                                                                                                                                                                               begin
                                                                                                                                                                                 if not exists (
                                                                                                                                                                                     select 1 from public.platform_admins p
                                                                                                                                                                                         where p.user_id = (select auth.uid())
                                                                                                                                                                                           ) then
                                                                                                                                                                                               raise exception 'Platform Super Admin access required'
                                                                                                                                                                                                     using errcode = '42501';
                                                                                                                                                                                                       end if;

                                                                                                                                                                                                         select jsonb_build_object(
                                                                                                                                                                                                             'totals', jsonb_build_object(
                                                                                                                                                                                                                   'institutes', (select count(*) from public.institutes),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                         'active_subscriptions', (select count(*) from public.institute_subscriptions where status = 'active'),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                               'trial_subscriptions', (select count(*) from public.institute_subscriptions where status = 'trial'),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     'other_subscriptions', (select count(*) from public.institute_subscriptions where status not in ('active','trial')),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           'suspended_institutes', (select count(*) from public.institutes where status = 'suspended'),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 'pending_institutes', (select count(*) from public.institutes where status = 'pending')
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     ),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         'institutes', coalesce((
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               select jsonb_agg(item order by created_at desc)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     from (
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             select jsonb_build_object(
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       'id', i.id,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 'name', i.name,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           'institute_type', i.institute_type,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     'status', i.status,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               'created_at', i.created_at,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         'plan_name', p.name,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   'subscription_status', s.status
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           ) as item, i.created_at
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   from public.institutes i
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           left join public.institute_subscriptions s on s.institute_id = i.id
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   left join public.subscription_plans p on p.id = s.plan_id
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           order by i.created_at desc
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   limit 500
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         ) recent
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             ), '[]'::jsonb)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               ) into result;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 return result;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 end;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 $function$

functions.name: get_coachingos_portal_dashboard
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_coachingos_portal_dashboard()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'linked_user_id', l.user_id,
        'institute_id', i.id,
        'institute_name', i.name,
        'relationship', l.relationship,
        'student_record_id', s.id,
        'student', jsonb_build_object(
          'name', s.record_data->>'name',
          'roll', s.record_data->>'roll',
          'class_name', s.record_data->>'class_name',
          'batch', s.record_data->>'batch'
        ),
        'attendance', coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
            'date', a.record_data->'date',
            'batch', a.record_data->'batch',
            'status', a.record_data->'status',
            'note', a.record_data->'note'
          ) order by a.created_at desc)
          from public.coachingos_records a
          where a.institute_id = l.institute_id
            and a.record_type = 'attendance'
            and (
              a.record_data->>'student_record_id' = s.id::text
              or a.record_data->>'student_id' = s.id::text
              or (
                nullif(s.record_data->>'name','') is not null
                and a.record_data->>'student' = s.record_data->>'name'
                and (
                  select count(*)
                  from public.coachingos_records s2
                  where s2.institute_id = l.institute_id
                    and s2.record_type = 'students'
                    and s2.record_data->>'name' = s.record_data->>'name'
                ) = 1
              )
            )
        ), '[]'::jsonb),
        'exams', coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
            'exam', e.record_data->'exam',
            'subject', e.record_data->'subject',
            'marks', e.record_data->'marks',
            'total', e.record_data->'total',
            'grade', e.record_data->'grade',
            'exam_date', e.record_data->'exam_date'
          ) order by e.created_at desc)
          from public.coachingos_records e
          where e.institute_id = l.institute_id
            and e.record_type = 'exams'
            and (
              e.record_data->>'student_record_id' = s.id::text
              or e.record_data->>'student_id' = s.id::text
              or (
                nullif(s.record_data->>'name','') is not null
                and e.record_data->>'student' = s.record_data->>'name'
                and (
                  select count(*)
                  from public.coachingos_records s2
                  where s2.institute_id = l.institute_id
                    and s2.record_type = 'students'
                    and s2.record_data->>'name' = s.record_data->>'name'
                ) = 1
              )
            )
        ), '[]'::jsonb),
        'fees', coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
            'month', f.record_data->'month',
            'amount', f.record_data->'amount',
            'paid', f.record_data->'paid',
            'due', f.record_data->'due',
            'date', f.record_data->'date',
            'receipt', f.record_data->'receipt'
          ) order by f.created_at desc)
          from public.coachingos_records f
          where f.institute_id = l.institute_id
            and f.record_type = 'fees'
            and (
              f.record_data->>'student_record_id' = s.id::text
              or f.record_data->>'student_id' = s.id::text
              or (
                nullif(s.record_data->>'name','') is not null
                and f.record_data->>'student' = s.record_data->>'name'
                and (
                  select count(*)
                  from public.coachingos_records s2
                  where s2.institute_id = l.institute_id
                    and s2.record_type = 'students'
                    and s2.record_data->>'name' = s.record_data->>'name'
                ) = 1
              )
            )
        ), '[]'::jsonb)
      )
      order by i.name, s.record_data->>'name'
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  from public.institute_portal_links l
  join public.institutes i
    on i.id = l.institute_id and i.status = 'active'
  join public.coachingos_records s
    on s.id = l.student_record_id
   and s.institute_id = l.institute_id
   and s.record_type = 'students'
  where l.user_id = (select auth.uid());
$function$

functions.name: get_coachingos_staff_audit_logs
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_coachingos_staff_audit_logs(_institute_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, event_type text, actor_user_id uuid, target_user_id uuid, invitation_id uuid, details jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              declare
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                caller_role text;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                begin
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  select m.role into caller_role
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    from public.institute_members m
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      where m.institute_id = _institute_id
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          and m.user_id = (select auth.uid());

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            if coalesce(caller_role,'') not in ('owner','admin','manager') then
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                raise exception 'Not allowed to view staff audit logs' using errcode = '42501';
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  end if;

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    return query
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      select l.id,l.event_type,l.actor_user_id,l.target_user_id,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               l.invitation_id,l.details,l.created_at
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 from public.institute_staff_audit_logs l
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   where l.institute_id = _institute_id
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     order by l.created_at desc
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       limit 100;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       end;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       $function$

functions.name: get_coachingos_staff_invitations
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_coachingos_staff_invitations(_institute_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, email text, phone text, role text, status text, created_at timestamp with time zone, expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
                                                                                begin
                                                                                  if not public.has_coachingos_institute_role(
                                                                                      _institute_id, array['owner','admin','manager']::text[]
                                                                                        ) then
                                                                                            raise exception 'Institute invitation access required'
                                                                                                  using errcode = '42501';
                                                                                                    end if;

                                                                                                      return query
                                                                                                          select i.id, i.email, i.phone, i.role,
                                                                                                                case when i.status = 'pending' and i.expires_at <= now()
                                                                                                                        then 'expired' else i.status end,
                                                                                                                              i.created_at, i.expires_at
                                                                                                                                  from public.institute_staff_invitations i
                                                                                                                                      where i.institute_id = _institute_id
                                                                                                                                          order by i.created_at desc
                                                                                                                                              limit 100;
                                                                                                                                              end;
                                                                                                                                              $function$

functions.name: get_coachingos_student_options
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_coachingos_student_options(_institute_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, name text, roll text, class_name text, batch text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    r.id,
    coalesce(r.record_data->>'name','') as name,
    coalesce(r.record_data->>'roll','') as roll,
    coalesce(r.record_data->>'class_name','') as class_name,
    coalesce(r.record_data->>'batch','') as batch
  from public.coachingos_records r
  join public.institutes i on i.id = r.institute_id and i.status = 'active'
  where r.institute_id = _institute_id
    and r.record_type = 'students'
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.institute_members m
      where m.institute_id = _institute_id
        and m.user_id = (select auth.uid())
        and m.role in ('owner','admin','manager','teacher','accountant','receptionist')
    )
  order by r.record_data->>'name';
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_coachingos_institute_status()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 begin
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   if new.status is distinct from old.status
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        and not exists (
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               select 1 from public.platform_admins p
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      where p.user_id = (select auth.uid())
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           ) then
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               raise exception 'Only Platform Super Admin can change institute status'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     using errcode = '42501';
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       end if;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         return new;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         end;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_coachingos_institute_role(_institute_id uuid, _roles text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
                                                                                              select exists (
                                                                                                  select 1 from public.institute_members m
                                                                                                      where m.institute_id = _institute_id
                                                                                                            and m.user_id = (select auth.uid())
                                                                                                                  and m.role = any(_roles)
                                                                                                                    );
                                                                                                                    $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_coachingos_notification_read(_notification_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
                                                                             begin
                                                                               if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Authentication required'; end if;
                                                                                 update public.institute_notifications
                                                                                   set read_at = now()
                                                                                     where id = _notification_id
                                                                                         and recipient_user_id = auth.uid()
                                                                                             and read_at is null;
                                                                                               return found;
                                                                                               end;
                                                                                               $function$
